# sy

> Modular desktop and agent environment for Fedora. The base RPM installs a command launcher; optional RPMs install feature executables and services for power, agents, authentication, AI inference, knowledge search, monitoring, desktop shell, and file management.

The RPM build workflow targets Fedora 43, 44, and 45. Hardware features may have narrower runtime qualification. The package names and dependencies in `packaging/sy.spec` are canonical. AMD Ryzen AI runtime packages and model files are external to sy.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): project overview, Fedora RPM build and install, feature package list, development commands.
- [Start here](docs/intro.md): product overview and documentation map.
- [Install sy from RPMs](docs/tutorials/getting-started.md): build packages for a Fedora host, install selected features, apply the packaged desktop config, verify.
- [Architecture](docs/explanation/architecture.md): launcher, feature executables, packages, user services, IPC, and NPU ownership.
- [What sy is](docs/explanation/what-sy-is.md): product goals, core and optional features.
